title: Supply of ABC Store pressure type fire extinguishers of 6 Kgs capacity with ISI Mark to Puducherry Lighthouse under Chennai directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supplying eight 6 kg ABC stored-pressure fire extinguishers (IS 15683, ISI marked) to Puducherry Lighthouse, Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

scope.item: Supply of ABC store pressure type fire extinguishers of 6 kg capacity with all accessories conforming to IS:15683 with ISI mark

money.notes: 100% payment after successful supply and satisfactory working of the extinguishers; final account bill basis on actual quantity. No escalation. Paying authority: Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Chennai.

period.completion: Supply within 20 days from date of supply order

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorised dealers or agents; quotation with credentials and descriptive brochures
specs: ABC stored pressure fire extinguisher, 6 kg, IS 15683, ISI marked
notes: Quotations due 24/04/2024 15:00, opened same day 16:00. No estimated cost or EMD printed. Directorate e-mail printed is a gmail address (office contact, kept out of record here).
